description: This file defines various minimal data structures for GitHub entities such as users, repositories, commits, releases, branches, and projects, along with helper functions to convert complex GitHub API objects into these minimal representations.

classes.name: MinimalUser
classes.description: Represents a minimal user or organization with login, ID, profile URL, and avatar URL.

classes.name: MinimalSearchUsersResult
classes.description: Represents a minimal search result for users, including total count, incomplete results flag, and list of users.

classes.name: MinimalRepository
classes.description: Represents a minimal repository with key metadata to reduce verbosity.

classes.name: MinimalSearchRepositoriesResult
classes.description: Represents a minimal search result for repositories.

classes.name: MinimalCommitAuthor
classes.description: Contains basic commit author information: name, email, date.

classes.name: MinimalCommitInfo
classes.description: Core commit information including message, author, and committer details.

classes.name: MinimalCommitStats
classes.description: Statistics for a commit: additions, deletions, total changes.

classes.name: MinimalCommitFile
classes.description: Details of a file changed in a commit.

classes.name: MinimalCommit
classes.description: A minimal representation of a commit, including SHA, URL, commit info, author, committer, stats, and files.

classes.name: MinimalRelease
classes.description: Minimal release object with ID, tag, name, body, URL, publication date, prerelease, draft, and author.

classes.name: MinimalBranch
classes.description: Minimal branch info: name, SHA, protected status.

classes.name: MinimalResponse
classes.description: Generic minimal response with ID and URL.

classes.name: MinimalProject
classes.description: Minimal project data structure with ID, owner, creator, title, description, timestamps, and deletion info.

methods.name: convertToMinimalProject
methods.description: Converts a full github.ProjectV2 object into a MinimalProject.

methods.name: convertToMinimalUser
methods.description: Converts a github.User object into a MinimalUser.

methods.name: convertToMinimalCommit
methods.description: Converts a github.RepositoryCommit into a MinimalCommit, optionally including diffs.

methods.name: convertToMinimalBranch
methods.description: Converts a github.Branch into a MinimalBranch.
